cost_profile.recommendation_rationale: The full-scale experiment (10 seeds, 500 words, 50 epochs) is projected to require 17.82 single-thread CPU core-hours (scaling factor 385.8x from 166.3s pilot). Peak process RSS measured 33.0 MB (heap 0.40 MB). Google Colab Pro (GPU acceleration) is recommended for larger natural corpora and rapid iterations, though parallel local multi-core execution (106.9 min across 10 cores) remains viable for moderate scale.

conclusions.summary_claim: Expanded controlled replay pilot technically validated. Data isolation (quadripartite partitioning without leakage) and physical gradient step budget parity (3 seeds) are strictly confirmed. Under high interference (prefix collision), directed replay (C) demonstrates positive mean recovery advantage over uniform random replay (B) (+0.3333) and superior holdout retention. Under low and medium interference, recovery advantage is zero due to minimal baseline forgetting. Because this pilot evaluated 3 exploratory seeds on synthetic micro-fixtures, these results provide promising methodological validation rather than a definitive proof of general superiority across all contexts. The protocol is verified, reproducible, and ready for scaled execution.
